symptom: Under `mdl 1;`, `retrieve $Item from Lm.Item where … limit 1; return $Item;` in a microflow returning Lm.Item passed check ("Expression types OK") and exec; mx check reported CE0117 "Error(s) in expression." at End event.
cause: MDL-RETRIEVE03 knew which variables a database retrieve bound to a list, but only judged `change $L` and `$L/Attr` as object uses; `return $L` against a non-list return type was not one of them.
insight: **A list-as-object rule must enumerate every object slot, and `return` is one.** Measured on 11.12.6: `limit 1` returned from a flow returning the entity → CE0117 at End event; `first` → 0 errors. A bare `Module.Name` return type is parsed as an enum-or-entity reference, so formatDataTypeForMDL printed it as "Unknown" — name it from EntityRef/EnumRef.
